purpose: Governance of generated Phase 1B reproducibility artifacts; not normative source files.
storage_policy: Retain the four existing files locally; exclude only these exact filenames from normal Git history. No deletion, upload or remote artifact archive has been performed.
verification: SHA-256 and sizes below identify the exact original local copies and match phase1b_provenance.json.
result_integrity: The four files existed at experiment completion and were checked in the final integrity audit. Their absence from a checkout does not invalidate the committed result: both experiments were independently reproduced from frozen configuration and matched the saved worlds, arrays, controls and reports.

regeneration.environment: Use the dependency versions recorded in phase1b_provenance.json and the matching source commit. The runner uses the frozen R1/R2 seeds. Run in a separate reproduction checkout to avoid overwriting original local evidence.
regeneration.comparison: Verify scientific reports and loaded NPZ arrays against phase1b_results.json. Check the hashes below to verify exact archived local copies. Equivalent data written with other newline/container formats may have different byte hashes.
regeneration.raw_hash_portability: Git normalises text line endings. The runner now reconstructs the documented CRLF manifest and LF_WITH_FINAL_CRLF plan profiles before comparing the unchanged frozen hashes. Historical raw-byte provenance verification of other files still requires the profiles below. Restore the historical text-byte profiles below in the separate reproduction checkout, then verify every provenance-tracked input hash before running. Do not change frozen hash constants or experiment settings.

profile_rules.LF: Use Git blob bytes with CRLF converted to LF.
profile_rules.CRLF: Use Git blob bytes normalised to LF, then replace every LF with CRLF.
profile_rules.LF_WITH_FINAL_CRLF: Use Git blob bytes normalised to LF; replace only the final LF with CRLF. Preserve all other bytes, including encoding/BOM if present.

regeneration.profile_validation: The historical bytes of every listed file were reconstructed in memory from commit Git blobs and matched the original SHA-256 in phase1b_provenance.json. No source files were rewritten.
